*Build order after the narrow W4-B diagnostic failed. Next active lane is broad Phase II mapping, matrix generation, controlled narrowing, and survivor portfolio expression.*

<!-- MM:BEGIN:DOCBODY -->

# 1. Current roadmap summary

The roadmap now moves from the failed narrow W4-B diagnostic to a broad Phase II funnel.

```text
W1, W2-SU, W2, W2-v2, W3-A, W3-B, W3-C are closed.
W3-D is stopped and deferred.
W4-A is diagnostic.
W4-B is FAILED_NARROW_DIAGNOSTIC.
P2-MAP / P2-MATRIX / P2-NARROW / P2-PORTFOLIO is the active path.
```

The first W4-B prototype beat recent-winner and random baselines but did not beat the best standalone child. The correction is breadth plus controlled narrowing, not another one-off router patch.

# 2. Active roadmap

| Lane | Description | Status |
|---|---|---|
| P2-MAP | Broad architecture, data, surface, market, feature, target, rule, and artifact map | Active |
| P2-MATRIX | Multi-family candidate generation across models, signals, router targets, decision rules, and markets | Next |
| P2-NARROW | Predeclared filtering for uplift, robustness, PIT/leakage, concentration, liquidity, cost, drawdown, and falsification | Next |
| P2-PORTFOLIO | Portfolio expression for survivors only | Conditional |

# 3. Candidate breadth

Model families to include in the matrix:

```text
Ridge
Elastic Net
Bayesian Ridge
Bayesian LASSO / sparse Bayesian proxy
Group LASSO
Sparse Group LASSO
PCR / PLS
XGBoost
Random Forest / ExtraTrees
Quantile regression
Contextual bandit
Mixture-of-experts
MAML / Reptile-style adaptation later, only after simpler families justify it
```

Router targets:

```text
child utility regression
child utility distribution
pairwise child-vs-best-child advantage
override probability
abstain probability
regime classifier + policy map
```

Decision rules:

```text
free routing
default-to-best-child override
confidence-bound override
Thompson-style sampling
risk-adjusted expected utility
drawdown-aware selection
```

Input scope:

```text
TA child features
regime / liquidity / volatility features
cross-asset features
macro features
sentiment / news features
crypto-specific features
alternative data
```

Unavailable input families must be marked blocked until PIT-safe and provenance-tagged sources exist.

# 4. Portfolio expression

Portfolio expression remains required, but it is no longer the immediate test for every W2/W3 candidate. A candidate must first survive P2-NARROW. The survivor portfolio layer covers sizing, exposure caps, turnover caps, liquidity / capacity, transaction costs, slippage / impact, volatility targeting, drawdown overlays, cash / abstention, rebalance cadence, and portfolio return streams.

# 5. Stop / continue rules

Continue from P2-MATRIX into P2-NARROW only when candidate artifacts identify the exact model family, signal family, router target, decision rule, input surface, train/test split, and comparator set.

Continue from P2-NARROW into P2-PORTFOLIO only when at least one candidate is classified `SURVIVOR_READY_FOR_PORTFOLIO`.

Stop or recycle the map if all candidates classify as `NARROWED_OUT_BASELINE`, `NARROWED_OUT_ROBUSTNESS`, or `FAILED_NARROW_DIAGNOSTIC`.

# 6. Current roadmap verdict

```text
The narrow W4-B implementation failed.
The failure does not invalidate routing or meta-learning.
The active Phase II roadmap is breadth first, then controlled narrowing, then portfolio expression for survivors.
No production, GATE-II, paper, or live claim is made.
```
